instruction:
Begin with `/home/user/Desktop/power_curve.fst`, `/home/user/Desktop/inflow_steady_base.dat`, and their version-matched dependencies. Only initialization inputs are preloaded; generate all scripts and result artifacts yourself.

The OpenFAST executable is `/home/user/miniconda3/bin/openfast` when working on `power_curve.fst`. Complete the following from the command line: 1. Write `/home/user/Desktop/run_cases.py` to generate `inflow_ws4.dat`, `inflow_ws8.dat`, `inflow_ws11.dat`, `inflow_ws15.dat`, and `inflow_ws20.dat`. Every input must use `WindType=1`, `RefHt=90 m`, and `HWindSpeed` equal to its filename speed. Generate the matching `case_wsX.fst` files under `/home/user/Desktop`, with each case referencing its own inflow. 2. Run all five 60-second cases and retain each text `.out` and normal-termination log under `/home/user/Desktop`. 3. Write `postprocess.py` to locate `Time`, `GenPwr`, and `RotSpeed` by header name and compute arithmetic means over `Time>=50 s`. 4. Save `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` as `ws, genpwr_kw, rotspeed_rpm`. 5. Do not use GUI or visualization tools.
